 AD Delhi to ban pre BS6 vehicles from November 1 to 31 January, 2027
 Read in हिंदी Desirazu Venkat October 24, 2026, 07:35 AM IST 3,122 Views Stage 1 of GRAP
 Restrictions on till 31 January, 2027
 With the onset of winter 2026, the Delhi government has introduced pollution control measures. They will be in place from 1 November till 31 January, 2027, and of them, the biggest measure is that non BS6 vehicles have been banned from entry in this period. The government will also implement a no PUC, no fuel rule across the region, which is expected to keep lower emission standard vehicles off the road.
 Further measures that will be implemented include staggered office timings and work-from-home arrangements to ensure reduced congestion on major roads. Finally, it has also doubled parking fees in public locations to encourage more people to use public transport. The latter has already been in force for quite a while now. The government has also imposed a ban on construction and demolition activities in the specified period.
 The NCR, over the last decade, has fought poor air quality and has implemented various measures with varying degrees of success. All its efforts have been combined into one effort called GRAP (Graded Response Action Plan). It comprises four stages, with each coming into play when the air quality crosses 300, 400, 450 and 450+ AQI points, respectively.
